def test_fee_rounded_to_two_decimals(self, monkeypatch):
        monkeypatch.setitem(policy.TRANSFER_FEES, "odd", (0.001, 0.333))
        result = fx.transfer_fee(100.0, "odd")
        assert result["total_fee_eur"] == round(0.001 + 100.0 * 0.333 / 100.0, 2)
